person.name: Fauzi Ahmad Ramdhani
person.headline: Government & institutional affairs professional.
person.positioning: International Relations graduate with hands-on experience in stakeholder engagement, consumer-facing program delivery, and data-informed analysis through institutional roles at Bank Indonesia, the Financial Services Authority (OJK) and the Ministry of Trade. Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives, manage large-scale public engagement programs, and translate complex information into clear, actionable communication. Eager to apply strong analytical, coordination, and people management skills in government relations, public affairs, trade and corporate communications roles, in companies as well as public institutions.

experience.unit: Directorate General of National Export Development
experience.summary: Supporting the Directorate General of National Export Development on export development programs, trade agreement coordination and SME export readiness. Prepared meeting minutes and policy briefs for inter-agency and bilateral trade meetings. Designed 5 export-readiness assessment forms for Business Counselling at the 41st Trade Expo Indonesia, using Google Apps Script. Coordinated the Campuspreneur SME program across 3 universities, from curation and technical meetings to official reporting. Drafted 3 activity proposals for the 2027 annual work plan of a bilateral trade-agreement capacity-building program.

experience.role: Assistant Intern, Consumer Education and Protection Department
experience.summary: Reviewed and processed more than 50 consumer dispute cases in the IASC portal. Mapped the mediation workflow between consumers and financial service providers to identify benchmarks for handling cases consistently. Internship evaluation: 9.0/10 (Very Good), assessed by OJK East Java.

Wrote at least five analytical reports on regional inflation and food security, used as input at TPID coordination meetings. Coordinated the publication of more than ten institutional programs with local governments, universities and community organizations, and handled documentation for stakeholder events. Delivered public education sessions on QRIS and digital financial literacy for 300+ participants.

Wrote more than 100 research-based, SEO-optimized articles on MSME digitalization. Adapted technical business topics for non-technical small-business owners, and worked with the marketing team on brand messaging.
